jobs.title: Senior AI Developer
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

Are you ready to join the forefront of technology innovation with Netcompany?


As one of the fastest growing technology companies, we are disrupting the marketplace and revolutionizing the way businesses operate. Our vision is to be the leading digital challenger in Europe whilst evolving the next generation of IT consulting.


Operating across both public and private sectors, we offer a comprehensive range of services from application development and seamless cloud migration to program delivery and service operations, our offerings are designed to meet diverse business needs

 **Job Description**  

As a Senior AI Engineer, you will play a key role in building, deploying, and maintaining machine learning and AI solutions that solve real business problems for our clients. Working alongside senior data scientists, engineers, and consultants, you will contribute to solutions across the full development lifecycle, from data preparation and model development through to production deployment and monitoring.

* Solution Development: Support the design and implementation of data science and AI solutions, translating defined requirements into working technical components.
* Modelling \& Analysis: Apply established data science and machine learning techniques to analyse data and solve business problems under the guidance of senior team members.
* Production \& MLOps: Build, test, and help deploy machine learning models into production environments. Contribute to the design and maintenance of MLOps pipelines to ensure solutions are scalable and maintainable.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Work with clients and internal teams to understand requirements and communicate technical findings clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Ethical AI \& Governance: Apply responsible AI principles and support adherence to governance and compliance standards in AI/ML development.
* Mentorship \& Knowledge Sharing: Mentor and guide junior data scientists and engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence.

 **Qualifications**  

* Proficiency in Python and C\#. SQL or R is a plus.
* Experience with Cloud AI services such as Azure ML, AWS SageMaker, GCP Vertex AI.
* Hands\-on experience with machine learning libraries such as scikit\-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
* Practical knowledge of algorithms and techniques such as regression, decision trees, random forest, XGBoost, k\-means, anomaly detection, and time series forecasting.
* Working understanding of model evaluation and explainability concepts, e.g. overfitting, bias, cross\-validation.
* Experience developing and implementing end to end observability and monitoring for AI.
* Experience working with large, complex, or messy datasets.


Knowledge of Public Sector:

* Understanding of the challenges and opportunities facing public sector organisations.
* Experience working with public sector data.
* Knowledge of public sector regulations and compliance requirements.


Desired Skills:

* Must be eligible for Security Clearance
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Commitment to continuous learning and development.

  

**Additional Information** **Benefits:**

* Hybrid working model with some flexible working
* 25 days’ holiday
* Private Medical Health care via Vitality
* Pension contribution, Life Assurance
* Professional certifications supported as part of learning and development.
* A range of retail discounts to enhance your lifestyle, encompassing restaurants, supermarkets, travel, leisure activities and health and well\-being services.
* Access to our Employee Resource Groups, our groups represent diverse backgrounds and provide a platform for colleagues to connect, learn, and support one another.


Join Netcompany, where we proudly hold the 5th position on the esteemed UK Top 50 Best Places to Work in the Glassdoor Employees’ Choice Awards for 2024\.


At Netcompany, we pride ourselves on our entrepreneurial spirit and our capacity for doing things differently. Our culture is built on fostering low bureaucracy, emphasizing high agility and promoting flexibility, enabling everyone to contribute their best.


Our journey began in the UK with the acquisition of Hunter Macdonald in 2017\. As one of Northern Europe's most accomplished IT companies, we have expanded our headcount globally to 7400\+ employees and have offices in UK, Denmark, Norway, Poland, Holland and Vietnam.


Netcompany is committed to providing an inclusive and barrier\-free recruitment process for anyone wishing to apply for a job with us. We operate a Disability Confident Interview Scheme which means that we offer guaranteed interviews to all applicants with a disability who meet the minimum criteria for a role. Applicants are asked to opt in, so please let us know if you wish your application to be considered under this scheme.


If you need any reasonable adjustments or extra support during the recruitment process, please contact us at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com.

jobs.description:
Builds, tests and maintains bespoke web and mobile applications that streamline how information is processed and shared across the organisation.
  
  

Works with stakeholders to identify opportunities, document expected benefits and deliver reliable, reusable application s and services.
  
  

Monitors applications in production, responds to failures and adapts solutions to changing needs.
  
  

Maintains a central library of shared components and documentation so applications are robust and supportable.
  
  

Supports integration delivery by building and maintaining APIs and integration points, working closely with the Integration \& Automation team where required .
  
  

Contributes to AI\-enabled workflow enhancements by integrating approved AI servicess and MCP patterns w here applicable, ensuring safe and compliant implementation.
  
  

Uses AI\-assisted development approaches to improve delivery speed and quality, applying a human\-in\-the\-loop model with appropriate governance, code review and testing.
  
  

Specialises in application development and works with stakeholders to identify o pportunities for application improvements, automation and AI\-assisted workflow enhancements.
  
  

Develops and builds application features from agreed specifications primarily using the Trust’s core stack (.NET/C\#, SQL Server, React, React Native, TypeScript, HTML/CSS /Tailwind ).
  
  

Supports the delivery and maintenance of application services (web and mobile), under the direction of the Principal Developer (Applications).
  
  

Supports the delivery and maintenance of SharePoint where required, including workflows, pages/sites and content updates .
  
  

Implements releases and environment changes in line with agreed CI/CD p rocesses .
  
  

Develops and runs tests to validate application changes .
  
  

Maintains and supports existing applications .
  
  

M onitors and fixes defects or performance issues where required .
  
  

Builds and maintains documentation to support reliable operations and change control.
  
  

Provides day\-to\-day coaching and support to junior team members or trainees, including task guidance, peer review and sharing good practice across application development .
  
  

By joining Team MPFT, you will be helping your communities and in return for this, we will support you by;
  
  

Supporting your career development and progression
  
  

Excellent NHS Pension scheme
  
  

Generous maternity, paternity and adoption leave
  
  

Options for flexible working
  
  

Up to 27 days annual leave (increasing with service up to 33 days)
  
  

Extensive Health and Wellbeing support and resources
  
  

If you work in our community teams, we pay for your time travelling between patients
  
  

Lease car if you complete more than 500 business miles per annum, fully insured and maintained (including tyres), mileage paid at lease car rate
  
  

Salary sacrifice car \- fully insured and maintained (including tyres), your gross pay is reduced by the cost of the vehicle before tax, NI and pension deductions are calculated, mileage paid at business rates
  
  

Salary sacrifice bikes up to £2k
  
  

Free car parking at all trust sites
  
  

Free flu vaccinations every year
  
  

Citizens Advice support linked with a Hardship Fund for one off additional support up to £250 (if the criteria is met)
  
  

We are proud to be a diverse and inclusive organisation and there is a choice of staff networks that help you meet like\-minded people.
  
  

Please be aware that the use of artificial intelligence (AI) in completing application forms will be monitored to ensure fairness and transparency. If you have used AI you must state this in your application.
  
  

Please note, we may be required to close this vacancy early if we receive a high volume of applications
  
  

Develop, enhance, deploy and support secure, accessible and reliable applications, using modern technologies, APIs and AI\-enabled solutions, while following agreed development, UI/UX, testing, documentation, monitoring and governance standards.
  
  

Plan and deliver application improvements in collaboration with stakeholders and colleagues, covering requirements, estimation, prioritisation, reporting, risk management, service improvement, knowledge sharing, coaching and continuous professional development.
  
  

Please see the full Job Description for further details about the role and its requirements.

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer (Java)
jobs.description:
**Job Description**  

Build the cloud platform that’s transforming electronics design. Altium 365 for cloud lets design engineers communicate, collaborate and bring their ideas to market more efficiently than any platform in the industry. These are some of the R\&D Software Engineering contributions you might make to Altium 365:

* Building new cloud\-native applications and scalable infrastructure
* Utilizing AI and ML to power advanced search capabilities
* Large\-scale data processing; data modeling; holistic, intent\-based API design
* Stateful and stateless services, relational databases, ORM frameworks


Altium offers the opportunity to conceive and build new product features for electronics engineers, and add your own ideas to the world’s most collaborative and efficient electronics design platform.


As a Senior Software Engineer, Backend, your primary focus will be developing complex cloud applications as part of the Altium 365 R\&D team.

 **A Day in the Life of Our Senior Backend Developer**

* Work with Java, AWS, multi\-tenant architecture, and distributed high\-load systems.
* Solve technical challenges at the intersection of engineering software, electronics, and cloud services.
* Collaborate with product managers, architects, and other engineers to deliver reliable, scalable features.
* In a team, contribute to technical decisions, code reviews, and continuous improvement.
* Share knowledge and help strengthen the team’s engineering practices.

 **Qualifications*** You are proactive, self\-motivated, and committed to continuous learning.
* You communicate clearly, collaborate effectively, and are open to different perspectives.
* You think beyond the immediate solution and anticipate problems early in development.
* You adapt well to changing priorities and requirements.
* You take ownership of commitments and see work through to completion.

 **Required Technology Experience**

* Experience designing and developing backend services and APIs.
* Experience with AWS services such as EC2, ECS, and RDS.
* Understanding of microservices and multi\-tenant architectures.
* Experience with relational databases, preferably MySQL.
* Familiarity with CI/CD, Git, Docker, and Kubernetes.
* Experience working with distributed systems and production cloud environments.

 **Nice to Have**

* Experience with .NET
* Experience modernizing or integrating complex enterprise applications.
* Knowledge of high\-load systems, performance optimization, or cloud observability.
* Experience with Firebird database.

 **Additional Information**  

Altium Limited, a part of the Renesas Group and headquartered in San Diego, California, is a global software company accelerating the pace of electronics innovation. We are redefining electronic product creation in a software\-defined world with our industry\-first cloud\-based platform that unites every stakeholder and phase of electronics development.


From startups to world’s technology giants, our digital platforms give more power to PCB designers, supply chain, and manufacturing, letting them collaborate as never before. At Altium, our teams are empowered to innovate, collaborate globally, and help create the future of electronics development.


We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Associate Technical Services Engineer II (Cloud)
jobs.description:
### **Associate Technical Services Engineer II (Cloud)**



MongoDB Technical Services Engineers use their exceptional problem solving and customer service skills, along with their deep technical experience, to advise customers and to solve their complex MongoDB problems. Technical Service Engineers are experts in the entire MongoDB ecosystem \- database server, drivers, cloud and infrastructure. This also includes services such as Atlas (database as a service), or Cloud Manager (which helps customers with automation, backup and monitoring of their MongoDB systems). Our engineers combine their MongoDB expertise with passion, initiative, teamwork and a great sense of humor to help our customers to be successful with MongoDB.



We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.



Due to the 24/7 nature of our support organization, certain events throughout the year will require volunteering for coverage outside one's normal work days or work hours (i.e. regional offsites, regional holidays, etc). These are typically announced weeks in advance with a sign\-up system that considers equitability.


### **Cool things you'll do**



You'll be working alongside our largest customers, solving their complex challenges \- resolving questions on architecture, performance, recovery, security, and everything in between. You'll be an expert resource on best practices in running MongoDB at scale, whatever that scale may be. You'll be an advocate for customers' needs \- interfacing with our product management and development teams on their behalf. And you'll contribute to internal projects, including software development of support tools for performance, benchmarking, and diagnostics.


### **What you need**



We consider all candidates with an eye for those who are self\-taught, insatiably curious, and multi\-faceted.



The ideal candidates should have strong technical experience in one (or more) of the following areas


* Systems administration
* Distributed systems
* Network Administration
* Database architecture and administration
* Application Architecture
* Data architecture and design
* Performance tuning and benchmarking
* Extra bonus points if you have experience in one or more of Java, Python, Ruby, C, C\+\+, C\#, Javascript, node.js, Go, PHP, or Perl


If you have an operations background, we prefer experience administering large\-scale production environments, including hardware, operating systems (e.g. Linux, Windows), networks (including firewalls and load balancers), as well as cloud\-based resources (e.g. AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform).



It's crucial for every candidate that they can check off all of these boxes


* 2\- 3 years of specific engineering experience in technical engineering
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
* Genuine desire to help people
* Uncontrollable urge to investigate and solve problems, with advanced diagnostic and troubleshooting skills
* Ability to think on your feet, remain calm under pressure and solve problems in real\-time
* Desire and ability to rapidly learn a wide variety of new technical skills
* Strong teamwork: willingness and ability to get help from team members when required, and the good judgment to know when to seek help

### **About MongoDB**



MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud\-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi\-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.



With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI\-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we're powering the next era of software.



Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It's what makes us MongoDB.



To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we're committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees' wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it's like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!



MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.



MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

jobs.title: Render Programmer
jobs.description:
**ABOUT US**
  

  

ARRISE sets the benchmark for service delivery and excellence in the iGaming industry. Playing a key role in the success of its clients, which include Pragmatic Play, a brand relied upon by the world’s biggest online casinos for its cutting\-edge products, ARRISE helps to deliver exceptional gaming experiences to millions of players worldwide.
  

  

Our global team of over 10,000 talented and driven professionals are shaping the future of iGaming. Headquartered in Gibraltar, we have offices spanning Canada, India, the Isle of Man, Latvia, Malta, Romania, Serbia, Bulgaria, and the UAE, and more exciting destinations on the horizon.
At ARRISE, we take pride in creating growth opportunities at all levels, constantly investing in our people while welcoming new colleagues and forging strategic partnerships that open new opportunities for success.
To achieve this, we bet on ourselves. We know that success is a collective effort, and our team is driven by ambition, collaboration, and a shared commitment to grow and succeed — while embracing every step of the journey.
Be part of the future of iGaming with 10,000 ARRISERS! See a job that excites you? Apply now, and our friendly recruitment team will connect with you soon. Your journey starts here.
  

  

**ABOUT THE ROLE**
  

  

Do you want to implement exciting, eye\-candy games, that perfectly complement the beautiful gaming studios we are building?
Do you want to control every aspect of the development process?
Do you want to do all the above, head to toe, with just a few colleagues, and be in full control of your time and the result?
If yes, look no further.
  

  

We are a large company, but this is a small new department. We are backed by ARRISE’s industry\-leading experts, allowing us to provide the next in iGaming experience, And we need you, a talented Senior or Intermediate Programmer, to further expand the small existing team we have put in place.
  

  

**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING**
* Discuss, clarify and understand the requested product
* Write the code needed to implement the required product
* When needed, be in touch with external teams and team members (artists, designers, directors and managers)
* Communicate, work with and help your colleagues
* Provide support for previous projects, when needed
**WHAT WE ASK OF YOU**


* Know at least one of the following programming languages: C\+\+, C\#, Java, Javascript
* Have a programmer mindset (logical skills; problem\-solving, solution\-finding: find specific solutions for specific problems, instead of using general approaches)
* Work as part of an extended team (teamwork and team player)
* 6 Years \+ experience needed
* C\# knowledge is a plus
* Quality\-oriented mindset
* English language is needed, as it is used in all external communication

### **General information**


Job Title
Construction Safety Engineer

Wednesday, September 23, 2026
AESC Office Location
Navalmoral de la Mata, Extremadura, Spain
### **Description \& Requirements**


Job Description
**Company Overview**
--------------------


AESC is a global leader in lithium‑ion and LFP battery technology, with a fast‑growing footprint across Japan, the UK, France, China, and the USA. It is now expanding in Spain with a €1‑billion gigafactory in Extremadura that will create up to 900 direct jobs in phase one. The Spanish facility is designed as the first net‑zero industrial park gigafactory in the country, in line with AESC’s mission to pioneer sustainable battery manufacturing.


**Role Purpose**
----------------


The **Construction Safety Engineer** will lead Health \& Safety management during the construction and installation of AESC’s battery gigafactory in Navalmoral de la Mata. The role sits within the Global Infrastructure \& Construction (GIC) team, reports to the Construction Manager and acts as the Owner’s H\&S representative on site. **The Engineer will make sure that contractors, suppliers and the Project Management Company (PMC) apply H\&S requirements in line with Spanish legislation, project standards and AESC’s requirements.** The work is **on site, focused on execution, coordination and control**. It involves close collaboration with the legally appointed Health \& Safety Coordinator (CSS), the PMC and Corporate EHS.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


**Project set\-up**


* Translate AESC Corporate EHS policies and standards into project\-specific H\&S requirements for construction and installation activities.
* Define H\&S requirements for contractors and suppliers, together with GIC and Corporate EHS.
* Align H\&S planning with the PMC and the legally appointed Health \& Safety Coordinator.
* Act as the Owner’s H\&S representative with the competent authorities when required.
**Construction \& installation**


* Lead on\-site H\&S supervision and coordination on behalf of GIC.
* Review contractors’ H\&S documentation (Construction H\&S Plans, RAMS, JSAs) and monitor how it is applied in the field.
* Monitor contractor compliance with applicable law, contractual requirements and the approved H\&S documentation, including the coordination of business activities (CAE) and subcontracting control.
* Coordinate daily with the Construction and Site Management teams so that H\&S is built into execution planning.
* Focus on the high\-risk activities typical of a battery plant build: heavy lifting, electrical works and energisation, hot works, work at height, confined spaces, and interfaces between contractors and equipment suppliers.
* Carry out site inspections, audits and safety walks, and escalate deviations through GIC project channels.
* Coordinate corrective actions with contractors, the PMC and the CSS, and follow them through to closure.
* Support incident investigations and make sure corrective and preventive actions are implemented.
* Report H\&S performance, KPIs and critical risks to Project Management and Corporate EHS.
* Escalate critical risks and recommend stopping work through project governance channels when there is serious or imminent danger.
**Close\-out \& handover**


* Make sure that the construction H\&S documentation and deliverables required for handover are complete and compliant.
* Work with Corporate EHS to align with commissioning and operational H\&S requirements.
* Support final inspections, audits and regulatory reviews related to construction safety.
  

  

Led by a diverse and experienced management team, AESC employs more than 14,000 professionals worldwide. The company combines state\-of\-the\-art technology, Japanese craftsmanship and a strong track record in safety to deliver advanced battery solutions. AESC offers a comprehensive portfolio across various cathode chemistries and form factors, including LFP, NCM/MCA, and pouch, cylindrical and prismatic cell formats.


We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or any other legally protected status.


Don’t you want to be part of this cutting\-edge and revolutionary company?


\#LI\-SD1


Requirements / Required skills
* Environment, Health, and Safety
* Health \& Safety
* Occupational Safety and Health Administration Training
* Contractor Safety
Qualifications
**Desired Requirements**
------------------------

  

  

* Degree in Engineering, Architecture, Building Engineering or a related technical field.
* Técnico Superior en Prevención de Riesgos Laborales covering the three specialities (Safety, Industrial Hygiene, Ergonomics \& Applied Psychosociology). Mandatory.
* At least 5 years of H\&S experience in large industrial construction projects, or at least 2 large industrial construction projects, with direct exposure to site execution, contractor management and multi\-interface environments.
* Proven experience coordinating H\&S on construction sites. The Coordinador de Seguridad y Salud qualification is highly valued.
* Proven experience supervising EPC/PMC contractors on multi\-contractor sites with complex interfaces.
* Hands\-on experience supervising high\-risk activities: lifting operations, electrical works, hot works, work at height and confined spaces.
* Solid knowledge of Spanish H\&S legislation, especially construction regulations (RD 1627/1997, RD 171/2004, Ley 32/2006\).
* Experience on the Owner/Client side, either directly or through a prevention service hired by the Owner, is a plus.
* Experience leading H\&S on at least one large project is a plus.
* Experience on industrial, chemical or energy projects is valued, especially gigafactories or lithium battery plants, as is having followed a project through to commissioning and handover.
* Experience working with international (e.g., Chinese) contractors and installers is a plus.
* NEBOSH or an equivalent international H\&S certification is a plus.
* Language Skills: Spanish – native or proficiency (mandatory); English – a plus.
* Based in Navalmoral de la Mata or within approximately 45 minutes by car, or willing to relocate. 100% on site.
* Strong leadership and authority on H\&S matters, including the ability to stop work when needed, with excellent coordination and stakeholder\-management skills, attention to detail, a proactive prevention mindset and the ability to perform under demanding project schedules.

Position Summary

We are seeking a Lead Developer
to lead the evolution of ProjectWise
within Bentley Infrastructure Cloud services powered by iTwin
. This role is pivotal in driving innovation, ensuring service reliability, and delivering best-in-class solutions in partnership with Product Management and UX teams.You will own end-to-end product delivery—including service uptime (SLA)—and make data-driven decisions based on telemetry and usage insights. The ideal candidate champions agile practices, cloud-native development, and multi-tenant microservices, while fostering an empowered, high-performing team culture.

Responsibilities

Lead and Inspire: Manage a global development team to deliver highly available, scalable, and performant cloud services.
Drive Transformation: Champion the shift to an “Empowered Teams” model and instill a cloud-first mindset across the organization.
Own Delivery Excellence: Ensure code quality, service uptime, and continuous improvement in engineering processes.
Strategic Decision-Making: Use data and telemetry to guide product adoption, prioritize investments, and optimize costs.
Collaborate Across Functions: Partner with Product Management, UX, and leadership to align on strategy and deliver commitments.
Build Talent: Recruit, coach, and develop top engineering talent to create a world-class development organization.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or Engineering (or equivalent experience).
Proven experience in cloud-native software development, including transforming legacy on-prem solutions.
Strong leadership skills with experience managing globally distributed teams.
Deep understanding of DevOps/SRE principles, multi-cloud architectures, and complex technical challenges.
Results-driven, strategic thinker with excellent communication and collaboration skills.
High intellectual curiosity and adaptability to emerging technologies and trends.
Coaching mindset with a passion for team development and continuous learning.

Please note if you are employed full-time, the salary for this position ranges from 5500 EUR gross (before taxes-Lithuania) depending on knowledge and experience.

If you are ready to take your development skills to the next level and be part of a team that is shaping the future of software, we want to hear from you! Apply now and embark on an exciting journey with Bentley!

Please submit resume in English.

This is a Hybrid role.
